cases.id: case:seeds: an empty garden pot is sown

cases.id: case:seeds: a garden pot holding a bush is not sown
cases.note: A garden pot holding a tea bush gets no crop.

cases.id: case:custom attachments: a placeable item is placed around the tractor
cases.note: Holding torches (listed in CustomAttachments) places torches around the tractor.

cases.id: case:custom attachments: an item that can't be placed is never put on the ground

known_issues: The three target cases that check that something was left alone (grown fruit tree, bush pot, field stone) are read right after the matching preserved case has shown that the tractor worked on the same patch; if the tractor did nothing at all, the preserved case fails first.
The suite uses one fixed config.json, so each option is probed in one setting only (for example, stone breaking is only probed switched off).

Field stones and fruit trees are added to the farm's object and terrain-feature collections directly, the way world generation adds them; torches and garden pots are placed with the game's placement action.
